answer: Each agent must stake a bonded identity whose nectar accrues only through verified work, and every heartbeat pulse of attestation is hashed into a shared beacon so a cloned identity cannot replay another's history. A sybil's forged echo of a legitimate transcript fails cross-node consistency checks, because the beacon binds each pulse to a unique stake lineage. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
